strategy_rules: Probabilities are the model's TRUE calibrated win probability — no display inflation (pitcher stats point-in-time)
Edge-first: singles and parlay legs rank by model edge (not raw win %). Value High = edge ≥12% + market disagrees.
Minimum 10% edge for official singles; skip thin singles unless a qualified parlay scores higher
Each day: highest edge-weighted score among qualified 2/3/4-leg parlays or +EV single
Official ticket locks at first 11 AM CT publish — never changes later in the day
Prove-out: 18% parlay / 12% single below $200 (~$3–4/bet at $17 wallet)
